title: Austin's $18.4M Property & Airport Land Deals
summary:
*   Approved an $18.4 million budget increase to purchase "One Texas Center," a significant property acquisition for the city.
*   Finalized legal and financial arrangements, including a lease, right of first refusal, and future reimbursement plan, for the One Texas Center acquisition.
*   Held a closed-door executive session to discuss major land acquisition, sale, or lease agreements concerning both Robert Mueller Municipal Airport and Austin-Bergstrom International Airport with state entities.
